architecture_refinement.reason: project_execution_data is not passive data: the project worker creates a Node project in that root and runs npm run build there. Keeping it on a noexec mount would break the production project lifecycle, while making every passive asset root executable would unnecessarily weaken the boundary.

vaults.executable_content_reason: npm ci and npm run build operate inside PROJECT_EXECUTION_OUTPUT_ROOT for governed 3D web delivery

copy_and_integrity_contract.source_access: temporary read-only bind mirrors of the eleven Docker volume roots
rejected_source_types: regular file with st_nlink other than one
copy_and_integrity_contract.file_hash: SHA-256 through an O_NOFOLLOW descriptor with before/after identity and metadata stability checks
copy_and_integrity_contract.copy_tool: rsync archive mode with numeric IDs, deletion parity, safe-link policy, and device/special-file exclusion
copy_and_integrity_contract.stable_copy_requirement: source-before equals source-after and source-after equals candidate for every root; retry at most three times and otherwise fail closed
copy_and_integrity_contract.receipt_privacy: persist only per-root counts, byte totals, and aggregate hashes; do not persist user filenames or file contents

docker_fail_closed_contract.binding: Docker local volumes with type ext4 and device set to the required /dev/mapper node
docker_fail_closed_contract.compose_mapping: long volume syntax with volume.subpath for least-privilege per-root exposure
docker_fail_closed_contract.missing_mapper_behavior: Docker mount fails and the scoped container does not start; an empty Docker volume underlay must remain empty
docker_fail_closed_contract.passive_asset_execution_behavior: direct execution from asset-vault is rejected by noexec
docker_fail_closed_contract.project_execution_behavior: direct execution is allowed only on project-execution-vault because the governed builder runs npm within that root
docker_fail_closed_contract.temporary_probe_image: already-present aionex-aios-backend:local with network disabled, read-only root filesystem, all capabilities dropped, and no-new-privileges
